verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents drafting and refining in chat with Copilot in Word, prompt-to-presentation generation in PowerPoint, and tweaking spreadsheets via chat in Excel. A hands-on community report concretely contradicts the iterative-editing claim: during a trial, Copilot in Word could only append to the end of the document, could not create tables or search and replace, and did not maintain formatting. missing for 10: explicit export/download documentation, independent corroboration that iterative edits work reliably, and detail on editing depth within Word/PowerPoint/Excel files.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export

citations.quote: Prompt Copilot with the task, add and upload notes, then refine in the chat—all with Copilot in Word.
